description: Na₃Gd(PO₄)₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. There are five inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.35-2.83 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.60 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.37-2.57 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.90 Å. In the fifth Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.72 Å. There are two inequivalent Gd sites. In the first Gd site, Gd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.38-2.79 Å. In the second Gd site, Gd is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Gd-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.64 Å. There are three inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 22-58°. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 55°. There is one shorter (1.54 Å) and three longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. In the third P site, P is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms. There are two shorter (1.55 Å) and two longer (1.56 Å) P-O bond lengths. There are twelve inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Gd, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Gd, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Gd, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Gd, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Gd, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Gd, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to four Na, one Gd, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Na and one P atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Gd, and one P atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Gd, and one P atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two Na, one Gd, and one P atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Gd, and one P atom.
